crossRefs.note: so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint;’
then you scare me with dreams, and terrify me through visions:
The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the…

translations.web: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
translations.bsb: They have turned night into day, making light seem near in the face of darkness.
translations.kjv: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
translations.asv: They change the night into day: The light, say they, is near unto the darkness.
